units: <cite ref="Gittin 13a:4">Gitt. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>עבדא בה׳ ניחא ליה</he> a slave prefers the dissolute life with a slave (to regular marriage with a free woman); <cite ref="Ketubot 11a:5">Keth. 11ᵃ</cite>
